title: Claims Payment Manual — RideLink Member Reimbursement Claims
content:
This chapter governs the member reimbursement claims of Non-Emergency Medical Transportation: when a claim is considered, how often one trip leg may be reimbursed, and the denial of a late claim. The filing period referred to is the RideLink level's claim filing period in calendar days.

## Clauses in force

1. **Filing window.** A reimbursement claim is considered only when received no later than the filing period after the trip date. The filing days are counted in calendar days from the day after the trip date, and a claim received on the last day still qualifies. The trip date is read from the registered trip, matched by its trip number.
2. **Once per leg and kind.** One trip leg is reimbursed at most once for each reimbursement type. Whether the leg already carries an approved claim of that type is read from the reimbursement ledger, matched by trip number, leg and reimbursement type.
3. **Late claim.** A claim received late is denied, with the denial reason that it was filed late.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses are no longer in force; each has been superseded by the current basis for its subject:

- that mileage is reimbursed only on RideLink Mileage Reimbursement, for a trip registered with a trip number before the appointment where the level requires it, at the level's mileage rate per approved mile measured by the level's distance basis for the round trip (the mileage amount under that clause being the approved miles times the rate, rounded to the cent);
- that attendance is proven by a paid claim on the member's plan claims with the trip's appointment date and destination provider, and that without one the claim is denied for no attended appointment;
- that an approved amount is paid within the level's payment period by the member's chosen payment method.

## Filing window — boundary cases

*Hypothetical, a 90-day filing period, trip date 1 June:* day 1 is 2 June and day 90 is 30 August.

| Claim received | Day of the window | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 29 August | Day 89 | Considered |
| 30 August | Day 90, the last day | Considered |
| 31 August | Day 91 | Denied as filed late |

## Once per leg — cases

| Hypothetical ledger position for the leg | A further approval of this type for the same leg |
|---|---|
| No approved claim of this type | Not barred by clause 2 |
| An approved claim of the same type already stands | Barred |
| An approved claim of a different type stands | Not barred by clause 2 |

superseded_clauses: Mileage is reimbursed only on RideLink Mileage Reimbursement, for a trip registered with a trip number before the appointment where mileage_trip_preapproval_required, at mileage_rate_usd per approved mile measured by mileage_distance_basis for the round trip.

Attendance is proven by a paid claim on plan_claims for the member with the trip's appointment date and destination provider; without one the claim is denied with denial_reason no_attended_appointment.
an approved amount is paid within mileage_payment_days by the member's chosen payment method
